# Keep Waco Wagging

> Keep Waco Wagging is a Waco, Texas dog-parent community and lifestyle brand, and the community home of Platinum Scoops. It publishes a free, regularly updated directory of dog-friendly and pet-friendly places in Waco, and provides home-based dog daycare and boarding, dog training, a summer dog camp, and poop scooping across the Waco area.

## Dog-friendly Waco
- [Dog-Friendly Waco directory](https://keepwacowagging.com/dog-friendly-waco): The local guide to dog-friendly and pet-friendly places in Waco — patios, coffee shops, breweries, parks, trails, dog parks, groomers, vets, pet boutiques, and dog-friendly hotels. Filter by category or neighborhood (Downtown Waco, North Waco, East Waco).
- [Where to Wag This Weekend](https://keepwacowagging.com/weekend): Weekly roundup of dog-friendly Waco events, markets, patios, and activities.

## Pet care and services (Waco, TX)
- [Dog daycare & boarding](https://keepwacowagging.com/pet-care): Home-based dog daycare and boarding with full-time attention, enrichment, and daily photo updates. Rated 5.0 on Rover.
- [Dog training](https://keepwacowagging.com/training): Lifestyle dog training — patio manners, loose-leash walks, puppy socialization, and calm-home skills.
- [Summer dog camp](https://keepwacowagging.com/summer-daycare): Themed summer weeks of supervised play, enrichment, and rest; drop in for a day or join the full week.
- [Dog of Honor wedding pet care](https://keepwacowagging.com/pet-care/weddings-events): A dedicated wedding dog chaperone for Waco weddings and events.
- [Platinum Scoops poop scooping](https://keepwacowagging.com/platinum-scoops): Weekly dog waste removal and yard care in Waco, from $25/week with the first cleanup included.
- [Book a service](https://keepwacowagging.com/book): Booking hub for daycare, boarding, camp, training, and wedding pet care.

## The Wag Club
- [The Wag Club](https://keepwacowagging.com/wagclub): Join Waco's dog-parent community — book doggie daycare, shop Wag Club gear, and join the list for local dog-friendly finds.
- [Shop the Wag Club](https://keepwacowagging.com/shop): Wag Club apparel and gear for Waco dog people.

## About
- [About Keep Waco Wagging](https://keepwacowagging.com/about): The people and story behind Keep Waco Wagging and Platinum Scoops.
- [Contact](https://keepwacowagging.com/contact): Get in touch with the Waco team.
